notes: SHIP v1.14.352 - HERO CARD: unify the fill, move the stage onto the mount. Ships §3 (partial) and §4 of design/FIX-DESKTOP-NAV-CARDS.md. CSS ONLY - two declarations, no JS, no markup, no data path, no logic. THE TWO SECTIONS CONFLICT ON THIS ELEMENT AND THE RECON IS WHAT RESOLVED IT. §3 says every card takes the shared near-black --rd-cardfill. §4 says the hero rack renders near-invisible - trays indistinguishable from void - and asks for a lighter card-local backdrop so they read. Applied naively to the same element those cancel: unifying .cc-rackhero to the near-black makes the backdrop DARKER, which is the opposite of what §4 needs. FINDING THAT MADE IT SOLVABLE WITHOUT TOUCHING THE LOCK: rackElevation_render3D builds its renderer with alpha:true (:33586) and never assigns scene.background - the only scene.background in the file (:18692, 0x04060a) belongs to forge3d_render, a different renderer with a different exposure. So the hero canvas is TRANSPARENT and composites directly onto whatever sits behind it. The card backdrop is therefore a real lever, and §4 is achievable as a hero-mount-scoped change with zero contact with the LOCKED §A rig - toneMappingExposure 1.1 at :33592 is marked locked in-source and was not touched, nor were the lights, fog, envMapIntensity or type colours. THE SPLIT: .cc-rackhero (the CARD) takes var(--rd-cardfill), so at its edges it is now the same black as every other Home card and §3's unification holds. The STAGE moves down onto .cc-rackhero-mount (the element that hosts the transparent canvas), so the lift is local to where the rack actually stands rather than washing the whole card. Card unified at the edges, lit only under the rack. WHAT THE OLD BACKDROP ACTUALLY WAS, AND WHY THE TRAYS READ AS VOID: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0, var(--cyan-dim), transparent 60%) over #04060a. --cyan-dim is rgba(92,242,255,0.08) - eight percent - and it was anchored at 50% 0, the TOP EDGE of the card. The light was ABOVE the rack, not behind it, and it was nearly nothing to begin with. Recentred to 50% 45% (behind the rack) at .14 and tightened to a 90%/70% ellipse. Same hue as the token it replaces, so no new channel meaning is introduced - cyan already read as the hero's accent on this card. ⚠ THIS IS THE ONE ITEM I CANNOT VERIFY MYSELF and it is a judgement call on a surface only the owner sees: .14 is a deliberate, modest lift chosen to make the silhouette read WITHOUT washing the card grey and losing the unification §3 just bought. If the trays still do not read on device, the next lever is the LOCKED exposure/lights, which is a STOP-AND-FLAG per the spec's own instruction and the RACK SCENE LOCK - I will not raise it without an explicit new ruling. If instead it now reads washed or hazy, the fix is to drop .14 back toward .10; both directions are a one-number change on a single declaration. HELD, STILL: the 'DEVICES section' card fill - the spec never identifies it, best match is the COMPONENTS card ~:35331 carrying an inline background:var(--surf-1), and the owner's ID is still outstanding, so nothing was touched there. The broader 22-site inline --surf-1 sweep stays parked (bigger diff, edits JS-generated HTML, and the spec itself says no logic changes). §3 is therefore PARTIAL by design, not by omission. Gates: inline-JS vm.Script x3, CSS brace net-0, three-stamp .351->.352, CRLF preserved, ?legacy=1 unaffected (#pg-cmd is redesign-only and never renders under legacy). DEVICE-VERIFY (clear SW first): Home with a Master loaded - the hero rack's populated trays should now be distinguishable from empty space at a glance, at arm's length; the hero card's EDGES should be the same black as the 98 RACKS stat tile and the assistant card, with no blue or grey cast; the glow should sit behind the rack, not as a band across the top of the card. Judge whether .14 is right - too dark, too washed, or correct. ROLLBACK: revert this commit - two CSS declarations, nothing depends on them.
